instruction: I need the italicized text to be more distinguishable. Can you change the color of all italic words to blue (RGB 0,0,255) to make them stand out better?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing color of all italic text to blue (RGB 0,0,255). Evaluator checks if all 21 italic runs have blue font color. Verified document has 21 italic text runs that need color formatting.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: all italic text must be blue (RGB 0,0,255)
Metric function logic is sound: iterates through all paragraphs and runs, identifies italic text, and checks color
Complete coverage: checks ALL italic runs, not just some
Correct comparison logic: uses exact RGB color matching (RGBColor(0, 0, 255))
Robust edge case handling: returns 0.0 for no italic text, handles errors gracefully, checks for None values
Postconfig correctly saves document before evaluation (Ctrl+S)
State extraction is correct: get_vm_file retrieves the modified document
Return value logic is correct: 1.0 only if all italic text is blue, 0.0 otherwise
